questions.solution_text:
$\angle ABC=144^{\circ}$ (interior angle of a regular decagon)

$x=(180^{\circ}-144^{\circ})\div2$

$\angle$ of a square $=90^{\circ}$
$x=360^{\circ}-135^{\circ}-90^{\circ}$

$AB=BC$, so $\angle BCA=(180^{\circ}-135^{\circ})\div2=22.5^{\circ}$; likewise $\angle DCE=22.5^{\circ}$
$x=135^{\circ}-22.5^{\circ}-22.5^{\circ}$
$=90^{\circ}$
